signatures.name: travel_cost_residence_effect
signatures.description: Marginal Value Theorem (Bustamante et al. 2023): a higher travel cost between patches should make the agent stay in the current patch longer. Tested as the stay-rate under high travel cost (8s) versus low (4s). Previously a Pearson correlation between travel_cost_seconds and harvests_stayed_in_patch on LEAVE trials only, which was untestable in 18/18 archived sessions: agents leave a patch just 32 times in 1,281 trials (2.5%), giving 0-7 paired observations per session against a minimum of 10. The over-staying is itself the divergence from MVT, and the stay-rate formulation measures it from every trial rather than only from the rare departures.

signatures.name: above_chance_mvt_match
signatures.description: Per-trial choices match the MVT-optimal prediction (stay if current reward exceeds the running block average per decision) above chance.

signatures.name: above_chance_total_reward
signatures.description: Reward per decision is above the random-policy baseline. Each decision yields >=1 apple if STAY and 0 if LEAVE; random play with prop_stay~0.5 averages ~25 per decision (current_reward * 0.5). Operationalised as proportion of decisions with harvest_reward > 25.

signatures.name: harvest_rt_speedup
signatures.description: Response time falls across successive harvests within a patch as the stay/leave decision becomes routine.
